question: With final combined E1 complete, compare critic supervisory gating with the simple threshold on handoff disruption and recovery speed, and assess reviewer readiness without writing replies.
mode: focused-audit with versioned final analysis and scientific figures
allowed_actions: read saved scientific data and paper roadmap
create a new assessment and figure package
excluded_actions: changing raw results or recovery archives
threshold_comparison_scope: E2 separately trained combined controllers, one realization per method and plant; no new threshold replications
recovery_primary_definition: Three consecutive episodes at or above matched nominal MPC reward, or with both output RMSEs no worse. Search episodes14-200; retain censoring and dwell1/5 sensitivity.
empirical_handoff_definition: Episodes14-20: output RMSE, peak physical error, normalized tracking-band excursions, reward and input movement. Tracking bands are not hard safety constraints.
readiness_scope: Check the existing24-comment roadmap and accepted E1-E7 scopes; do not answer or mark comments resolved.
